source: INVARIANT_F_TYPES_HYPHEN / INVARIANT_LEADING_HYPHENS_COMPOSE_IN_BUFFER (§62 / §21, docs/architecture/behavioral-invariants.md): with Type - with f on, an idle `f` is the `-` key, so `ff` enters composing as `--` and `ah` continues in-buffer to `--ah`; Enter commits the preedit as typed. `telex-idle-z` is the control that an idle tone letter still passes through.
